summary: DevvStream, an Alberta carbon-credit company, filed an 8-K disclosing Amendment No. 1 to its April 13, 2026 Business Combination Agreement with XCF Global and Southern Energy, restructuring the three-way merger's consideration. The amendment resets pro forma ownership: Southern Energy holders receive XCF shares equal to roughly 28.75% of the combined company, with DevvStream's split correspondingly adjusted. No per-share price, premium or break fee is stated. XCF's Form S-4 (No. 333-296774) joint proxy/prospectus remains pending; shareholder votes and regulatory clearances are outstanding. Watch the revised ownership split, vote timing, redemptions and any further amendments as deal-risk markers.
